Karnataka Parties Decline Drought Relief Delegation to PM Modi

In Karnataka, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Janata Dal (Secular) have declined to join an all-party delegation from the state government intended to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi to discuss drought relief. Karnataka Congress leader D.K. Shivakumar criticized the BJP and JD(S) for their refusal. Meanwhile, hardy crops are reportedly failing in drought-affected regions of the state.
